hero.title: Vicenzaoro September 2026 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Vicenza
hero.lead: Vicenzaoro September 2026 – Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Vicenza
hero.para1: Vicenzaoro September 2026 will take place from 4–8 September at Fiera di Vicenza in Vicenza, Italy. This international B2B exhibition brings the gold, jewellery, watchmaking and manufacturing supply chain together as European businesses prepare new collections and year-end purchasing plans.
hero.para2: Meet Uniglo Diamonds in Hall 3, Stand 136 to discuss natural diamonds for retail, wholesale, bridal, bespoke and jewellery-manufacturing requirements. Buyers can review available shapes and specifications, discuss matched or calibrated selections and explore sourcing requirements based on their intended market, product and production schedule.
hero.para3: Retailers, manufacturers, wholesalers, designers and professional buying teams can book a meeting before the exhibition and submit their diamond requirements in advance.
hero.primaryCta: Book a Meeting at Hall 3, Stand 136

datesAndVenue.title: Vicenzaoro September 2026 Dates and Venue
datesAndVenue.para1: Vicenzaoro September runs from Friday 4 September to Tuesday 8 September 2026 at Fiera di Vicenza.
datesAndVenue.para2: The exhibition is open from 10:00 to 18:30 from Friday through Monday. On Tuesday, the final day, it closes at 17:00. Visitors arranging several supplier meetings should avoid leaving important appointments until Tuesday because of the earlier closing time.
datesAndVenue.para3: Vicenzaoro and T.Gold use the same 4–8 September dates. VO Vintage, the separately organised event for vintage watches and jewellery, runs from 4–7 September.

whatIs.title: What Is Vicenzaoro September?
whatIs.para1: Vicenzaoro is a trade exhibition serving the international gold, jewellery and watchmaking industries. Its September edition marks the restart of the European jewellery calendar after the summer period and gives buyers an opportunity to refresh collections, plan purchases and prepare for the holiday season.
whatIs.para2: The organiser presents more than 1,300 exhibitors across the jewellery supply chain. The exhibition covers high-end and contemporary jewellery, unbranded production, diamonds and coloured gemstones, mountings, semi-finished components, packaging, visual merchandising, watches and manufacturing technology.
whatIs.para3: Its location in Vicenza gives the event a strong connection to Italian goldsmithing and jewellery production. International buyers can examine finished collections while also meeting businesses involved in the materials, components and technologies used to manufacture them.
whatIs.imageAlt: Vicenzaoro September 2026 exhibition at Fiera di Vicenza

whatCanBuyers.title: What Jewellery Buyers Can Source at Vicenzaoro 2026
whatCanBuyers.intro: Vicenzaoro divides its offering into specialised communities and curated exhibition areas. This helps professional visitors focus on the products and suppliers relevant to their businesses. The main sourcing categories include:
areas: Diamonds, coloured gemstones, corals and pearls
whatCanBuyers.outro: The ESSENCE Gems, Diamonds, Corals & Pearls area is particularly relevant to diamond and gemstone buyers. Manufacturers may also benefit from visiting CREATION Mountings & Semi-Finished and the integrated T.Gold technology exhibition.

meet.title: Meet Uniglo Diamonds at Vicenzaoro September 2026
meet.para1: Professional buyers can meet Uniglo Diamonds in Hall 3, Stand 136 to discuss natural-diamond sourcing requirements directly with the Antwerp team.
meet.para2: The discussion can begin with an individual centre stone, a matched pair, calibrated diamonds for manufacturing or a broader requirement for a retail or wholesale assortment.
meet.para3: Submitting this information before the exhibition gives the team time to understand the requirement and prepare a more relevant meeting.

europeanBusinesses.title: Diamond Sourcing for European Jewellery Businesses
europeanBusinesses.para1: European jewellery businesses often require diamonds for established product ranges, Italian-made settings, private-label collections, bridal lines and bespoke commissions. Each use creates different commercial and technical requirements.
europeanBusinesses.para2: A retailer preparing a bridal range may need individually documented centre stones across several recognisable shapes and price positions. A manufacturer may require calibrated diamonds with measurements compatible with an existing mounting. A wholesaler may need commercially relevant specifications for customers operating across several European markets.
europeanBusinesses.para3: Uniglo Diamonds evaluates a sourcing request according to how the diamond will be set, manufactured, positioned and sold — not only according to the grades printed on a report.
europeanBusinesses.considerLabel: Sourcing decisions may need to consider:
considerItems: Consistency across matched or multi-stone jewellery
Documentation required by the intended market
Target retail and wholesale price positions
Balance between core and distinctive diamond shapes
europeanBusinesses.para4: The September timing is especially relevant to businesses finalising production and inventory for Christmas, New Year and the following bridal season.

shapes.title: Natural Diamond Shapes for European Markets
shapes.para1: Diamond-shape preferences vary between countries, retailers, price categories and customer groups.
shapes.para2: Round Brilliant diamonds remain important for engagement rings, diamond earrings, tennis jewellery and classic fine-jewellery designs. Oval, Pear and Marquise diamonds provide elongated outlines and can create a different face-up appearance.
shapes.para3: Emerald and Asscher cuts offer step-cut faceting and a more architectural character. Cushion and Radiant diamonds combine distinctive outlines with stronger brilliance, while Princess-cut diamonds may suit square and geometric jewellery designs. Heart-shaped diamonds can support romantic, gifting and highly personalised pieces.
shapes.para4: Rather than treating every shape as suitable for every market, buyers should consider how the diamond will work with the setting, collection identity, customer preference and intended price position.
shapes.para5: Availability varies, so buyers should provide both preferred specifications and acceptable alternatives.

measurements.title: Diamond Measurements, Proportions and Appearance
measurements.para1: Carat weight is important, but it does not provide a complete picture of a polished diamond.
measurements.para2: Two diamonds with the same stated weight may have different measurements, outlines and face-up appearances. This is particularly relevant for fancy-shaped diamonds, where length-to-width ratio and overall proportions can influence how a stone looks in a finished design.
measurements.para3: A European manufacturer may require exact measurements for an existing mounting. A retailer may prefer an Oval or Emerald diamond within a defined ratio. A designer may need proportions that support a particular creative direction.
measurements.considerLabel: Buyers should consider whether their requirements include:
considerItems: Specific length, width or depth measurements
Visual characteristics not explained by grade alone

bridal.title: Natural Diamonds for Bridal and Fine-Jewellery Manufacturing
bridal.para1: Bridal jewellery remains one of the most commercially important applications for polished natural diamonds.
bridal.para2: Retailers may require documented centre stones across several shapes, sizes and quality combinations. Manufacturers may need centre diamonds and matched side stones for repeatable engagement-ring designs. Bespoke jewellers may instead require one particular diamond selected around an individual client's preferences.
bridal.para3: A balanced bridal assortment may combine recognisable core options with selected fancy-shaped diamonds for customers seeking a more individual design.

matching.title: Matching and Calibration for Jewellery Manufacturing
matching.para1: Matching becomes especially important when several diamonds will be used in one piece of jewellery.
matching.para2: Diamond earrings, three-stone rings, eternity bands, tennis bracelets, tennis necklaces and other multi-stone designs may require consistency across measurements, shape, colour, clarity and visual appearance.
matching.para3: For manufacturers, calibration can also influence setting efficiency and production repeatability. Diamonds that vary substantially in size or proportion may require adjustments and can produce an uneven finished appearance.
matching.imageAlt: Matched and calibrated natural diamonds from Uniglo Diamonds

certification.title: Diamond Certification and Documentation Requirements
certification.para1: Documentation requirements can vary according to the diamond's size, value, destination, intended market and customer expectations.
certification.para2: Some buyers require individual grading reports for centre stones. Others may require commercial documentation appropriate to smaller diamonds, calibrated selections or multi-stone layouts. Import, export, insurance and internal inventory procedures may create additional requirements.
certification.considerLabel: Before meeting Uniglo Diamonds, buyers should identify:
considerItems: Whether individual grading reports are required
Requirements for parcels, pairs or layouts
certification.para3: These matters should be discussed before a final selection is prepared.

antwerp.title: Antwerp Expertise for Italian and European Jewellery Production
antwerp.para1: Vicenzaoro connects Italian manufacturing expertise with suppliers and buyers from international markets. Uniglo Diamonds contributes an Antwerp-based perspective to this environment.
antwerp.para2: Antwerp's diamond-trading infrastructure gives Uniglo Diamonds experience working with different shapes, specifications and commercial requirements. The value of that experience depends on how well it supports the buyer's actual product and market.
antwerp.para3: Uniglo Diamonds therefore begins by understanding what the buyer plans to manufacture, stock or sell. This may involve a retailer sourcing engagement-ring centre stones, an Italian manufacturer preparing a repeat collection, a wholesaler serving several European markets or a designer developing a specialised diamond-led range.
antwerp.para4: Clear communication, accurate specifications, suitable documentation and consistent follow-up remain essential throughout the relationship.

prepare.title: What Buyers Should Prepare Before Vicenzaoro
prepare.para: Vicenzaoro is a large exhibition. Buyers can use their time more effectively by preparing a concise sourcing brief before meeting the Uniglo Diamonds team. The brief may include:
items: Images of current or planned jewellery
prepare.note: Buyers do not need to arrive with a final order. An initial meeting can establish whether Uniglo Diamonds' sourcing capabilities correspond with the business's immediate or future requirements.
prepare.cta: Book a Vicenzaoro Meeting at Stand 136

communities.title: Vicenzaoro's Jewellery Communities and T.Gold
communities.intro: Vicenzaoro uses specialised communities to organise different parts of the jewellery supply chain. The most relevant areas for many diamond buyers and manufacturers include:

items.title: ESSENCE Gems, Diamonds, Corals & Pearls
items.body: Diamonds, gemstones, pearls and other precious materials.

items.title: CREATION Mountings & Semi-Finished
items.body: Mountings, components and elements used to construct finished jewellery.

communities.note: Beginning with the September 2026 edition, T.Gold is integrated into the Vicenzaoro exhibition grounds in Hall 4. This gives manufacturers an opportunity to examine machinery and production technologies alongside jewellery, materials and components. Visitors should check the official exhibitor catalogue and floor plan before travelling.

planVisit.title: Planning Your Visit to Vicenzaoro
planVisit.registrationPara1: The main Vicenzaoro exhibition is reserved for jewellery-industry professionals. Admission is free, but online registration is mandatory.
planVisit.registrationPara2: Visitors should complete registration and obtain their badge before arriving. The organiser may request professional or business information during registration. Attendees should carry their badge and valid identification.
planVisit.hoursPara: Buyers should allow time for entry, movement between halls and unplanned sourcing conversations.
planVisit.tgoldPara: T.Gold runs from 4–8 September and focuses on machinery and technology for jewellery and precious-metal manufacturing.
planVisit.vintagePara: VO Vintage runs from 4–7 September and is dedicated to vintage watches and jewellery. Unlike the main trade exhibition, VO Vintage is open to collectors and members of the public under its own admission arrangements.
planVisit.gettingPara1: Fiera di Vicenza is located at Via dell'Oreficeria 16, 36100 Vicenza, Italy.
planVisit.gettingPara2: The venue is near the Vicenza Ovest exit of the A4 motorway. Vicenza is situated on the Milan–Venice railway line, and international visitors commonly travel through airports serving Verona, Venice and the wider region.
planVisit.gettingPara3: The organiser publishes current parking, shuttle and transport information. Visitors should check those details before departure because services and routes may change during the exhibition.

partnerships.title: Building Partnerships Beyond the Exhibition
partnerships.para1: The commercial value of an exhibition meeting is not limited to the diamonds examined on the day.
partnerships.para2: After meeting Uniglo Diamonds, a buyer may choose to:
nextSteps: Request a more focused diamond selection
Prepare a matched pair or calibrated layout
partnerships.para3: The objective is to establish a clear understanding of the buyer's market, intended jewellery, quality expectations and future requirements.

items.question: When is Vicenzaoro September 2026?
items.answer: Vicenzaoro September 2026 takes place from Friday 4 September to Tuesday 8 September 2026.

items.question: Where is Vicenzaoro September 2026 being held?
items.answer: The exhibition is held at Fiera di Vicenza, Via dell'Oreficeria 16, 36100 Vicenza, Italy.

items.question: What are the opening hours?
items.answer: Vicenzaoro is open from 10:00 to 18:30 from Friday through Monday. It is open from 10:00 to 17:00 on Tuesday.

items.question: Is Vicenzaoro open to the public?
items.answer: The main Vicenzaoro exhibition is reserved for jewellery-industry professionals. VO Vintage has separate arrangements and is open to collectors and the public.

items.question: Is admission free?
items.answer: Yes. Admission is free for registered jewellery-industry professionals, but registration is mandatory.

items.question: How do visitors register?
items.answer: Visitors must register through the official Vicenzaoro registration platform and obtain an event badge before entering.

items.question: Where can buyers find Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Uniglo Diamonds will be in Hall 3, Stand 136 at Vicenzaoro September 2026.

items.question: What can buyers discuss with Uniglo Diamonds?
items.answer: Buyers can discuss natural diamonds based on shape, carat weight, measurements, colour, clarity, documentation, matching, quantities and intended jewellery applications.

items.question: Can buyers discuss matched or calibrated diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers can discuss matched pairs, coordinated side stones, calibrated diamonds, eternity-band layouts, tennis-jewellery layouts and repeat manufacturing specifications.

items.question: Can Uniglo Diamonds support European jewellery manufacturers?
items.answer: European manufacturers can discuss diamonds for existing mountings, production tolerances, matched designs, repeat collections and planned manufacturing schedules.

items.question: Can buyers discuss bridal diamonds?
items.answer: Yes. Requirements can include engagement-ring centre stones, matching side stones, diamonds for wedding and eternity bands and stones for bespoke bridal jewellery.

items.question: What is T.Gold?
items.answer: T.Gold is the exhibition dedicated to machinery and technology for the jewellery and goldsmith industries. It runs from 4–8 September 2026 and is integrated into Hall 4.

items.question: What is VO Vintage?
items.answer: VO Vintage is an event dedicated to vintage watches and jewellery. It runs from 4–7 September 2026 and has separate public-access arrangements.

items.question: Can buyers book a meeting before Vicenzaoro?
items.answer: Yes. Buyers should book in advance and provide their sourcing requirements so Uniglo Diamonds can prepare a more relevant discussion.
